newsitem.title: ITALY: Turkish ship in difficulty off S.Italy coast.
newsitem.headline: Turkish ship in difficulty off S.Italy coast.

text.p: A ship believed to be carrying as many as 150 illegal immigrants was in danger of sinking off the coast of southern Italy, coastguard officials said on Friday.

An official at the coastguard command in Rome told Reuters that the ship, believed to be Turkish and about 30 metres long, had sent out an distress signal while off the coast of the Puglia region. A rescue operation was underway and it was not clear if there were any victims.
The coastguard said the captain of the ship had said by radio that he had about 150 people on board who had been planning to enter Italy illegally.
The name and home port of the ship were not immediately known.
The vessel was beleived to be in the Ionian Sea off the coast of Santa Maria di Leuca on the southern tip of the Puglia region.
Rescue vessels and a plane were heading towards the ship.
